methodology.identification_items: All 666 distinct cold test targets; 666 distinct warm test targets greedily matched on title word count with seeded tie order.
methodology.history_rows: Seeded random rows within cold/warm test strata; no target-dependent generation.
methodology.history_title_mapping: Raw and casefold/whitespace title exact match; TF-IDF is lexical catalog lookup, not a semantic encoder.
methodology.content_cosine: Computed only when generated title exactly matches a catalog title after case/whitespace normalization; ambiguous-title maximum cosine is marked conditional, not zero-filled.
methodology.scope: Descriptive post-hoc diagnosis; direct title->SID is known-metadata recognition, not recommendation accuracy.
